build_tree_grower: build a TreeGrower instance to grow a histogram-based gradient boosting decision tree from binned features, gradients, and hessians
test_split_next: test the TreeGrower.split_next method to apply the best split and compute splits for newly created child nodes
test_grow_tree: test the TreeGrower.grow method to grow a full decision tree respecting min_gain_to_split and max_leaf_nodes constraints
test_make_predictor: test the TreeGrower.make_predictor method to create a predictor object from a grown tree for batch predictions
test_min_samples_leaf: test the TreeGrower.min_samples_leaf parameter to ensure leaf nodes contain at least the specified number of samples
test_max_depth: test the TreeGrower.max_depth parameter to ensure tree depth does not exceed the specified maximum
test_grow_tree_categories: test the TreeGrower with is_categorical feature flag to validate native categorical splits using bitsets
test_ohe_equivalence: test that native categorical splits produce predictions equivalent to one-hot encoded features
test_grower_interaction_constraints: test the TreeGrower interaction_cst parameter to enforce feature interaction constraints across tree nodes
test_split_on_nan: test that split_on_nan situations are handled correctly with infinite values and missing value routing
